integrity: Self-contained proof and reproducible finite checker; earlier bipartite and complete-graph results acknowledged, no independent audit represented.
scientific_limitations: Only twice-uniform words for labeled noncomplete complete multipartite graphs with r>=3. Neither reversal nor label permutations are quotient symmetries. General k-uniform words and all-complete or bipartite graphs are outside the new claim. Full 2018 chord-expansion article was unavailable and equivalence cannot be ruled out absolutely.
title: Cyclic normal forms for complete multipartite double-occurrence representations
